text: Next, S, the synthesis phase, where the DNA is replicated. As copying proceeds, the DNA mass per cell rises. It is drawn as a slope because replication takes time; the straight line is schematic. By the end of the S phase the chromosome is two sister chromatids, copies of each other, joined at the centromere: still one chromosome, two DNA molecules. Our model cell now has four chromosomes and eight DNA molecules; a typical diploid human body cell, forty-six and ninety-two.
